answer: Ephemeral Challenge Windows. Each identity must answer a fresh challenge derived from a public randomness beacon within a short window; the cipher binding the response to that beacon value cannot be prepared earlier. Missed windows decay the identity’s standing on a per-account jetty of rate limits. A real operator must keep hardware live and online around the clock for every identity it runs, so mass-registering N identities costs N continuous availability commitments rather than N one-time registrations, while any haven of precomputed answers fails once the beacon rotates.
